The cemetery has been converted into a small, walled town with the living sharing their space with the headstones of the dead.}} [[Venta Cemetery (outpost)|Venta Cemetery]] is the first [[mission outpost]] in the [[region]] of [[Kourna]], making it the first mission after the missions on the island of [[Istan]]. ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[And a Hero Shall Lead Them]] will end up bringing characters here. This mission outpost is situated at the northeastern corner of Sunward Marches. ==Exits== *[[Sunward Marches]] (southwest) *[[Turai's Procession]] (northeast) ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 20 [[Dijahpo]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Odurra]] (Domination) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) *{{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) *{{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) ===Other allies=== *{{e}} 20 [[Rojis]] (mission starter) *{{x}} 10 [[Elonyam]] (mission briefing) *{{x}} 10 [[Kournan Peasant]]s *{{x}} 2 [[Kournan Child]]ren ==Notes== *The [[world map]] actually marks this location with the icon for an outpost upon initial arrival. It changes into the icon for a mission outpost only upon completion of the quest that precedes the [[Venta Cemetery|Venta Cemetery mission]]. ==Trivia== *The map that was part of the boxed content of a [[Guild Wars Nightfall#Guild Wars Nightfall Collector's Edition (box content)|Collector's Edition]] of Guild Wars Nightfall labels this outpost as "Cemetery of Dunahm". {{Towns and outposts in Kourna}}
